state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 4.** `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]` (`crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs`'s module doc). `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs` has an owned `Cursor` advanced with `&mut Connection`, and `Search<'_>` is now that cursor plus the borrow. A connection counts its cursors with pages left on the server, and `is_settled` is false while any does. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections (`connect`, `open`) and runs `who_am_i`, `search` (returns an owned `Entries`, first page read at the call) and `read` (base scope, `None` for `noSuchObject`). Both module docs own those rules.

`nvs-stdlib-ldap-connect-open-and-search`'s five tests pass against `samba-ad`. The size limit test uses a scripted loopback peer, because Samba ignores a client's size limit. Nothing is registered in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs` yet, so no Novis program can call `Core\Ldap`, and `ldap-connect-and-search-run`'s two `.nvst` cases are not written.

A failure still throws through `fault_of` as `RuntimeError`, `IOError` or `TimeoutError`. `rule:security/ldap-pool-is-bound-as-its-block` stays `designed` until a Novis case guards it.

items.text: **`Ldap\LdapError` with `$kind` and `$code`.** Add it to the tree at `crates/nvs-hir/src/errors.rs:115` and `OWN_PROPERTIES`, then to `ThrownClass` at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/throwable.rs:370`, and give it the `nvs_types::error_lib` property arm `Core\Db\DbError` has. Then make `fault_of` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:138` throw it. ADR 0278 § 10, `rule:core-classes/db-error` for the shape.

**The registry rows and helpers**: `Core\Ldap::connect`/`open`, `Ldap\Connection::search`/`read`/`whoami`, `Ldap\Entries` (over `nvs_stdlib::ldap::Entries` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:385`, whose `next` takes the `Ctx`), `Ldap\Entry` (`dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes`, `toArray`), `Ldap\Settings`, `Ldap\Tls`, `Ldap\Scope`, `Ldap\ErrorKind`, with a reference card for each. Follow the way `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/db/registry.rs:228` declares `Core\Db::connect`. `search` takes a `Filter`, so this slice needs the smallest `Ldap\Filter` (`equals`, `present`) from Stage 5. Then write `tests/conformance/core/ldap-connect-and-search.nvst` and `ldap-connect-without-a-grant-throws.nvst`.

backlog: `open` connections are not pooled. ADR 0278 § 4 keys that pool on every URL, the user, a password digest, the TLS mode and the CA file (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` module doc).

The `ldap:` pool and memo prefix shares its namespace with a `[db."ldap:x"]` block name. The downcast to `Held` keeps the two types apart, but a memo hit would throw "closed". Not checked whether any config rule forbids that name.
Ranged attributes (`member;range=0-1499`) are not merged yet; ADR 0278 § 5 puts it in Stage 6.
